snippet.title: Ghost Transmission - Official Announcement Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the Announcement Trailer for Ghost Transmission, a co-op horror survival game for 1–4 players. Investigate haunted locations, gather evidence, and seal the entity before it gets inside you. Ghost Transmission will be available on PC in 2027.
